paragraphs: Mentioned at the beginning of Ruth Rabbah, chapter 1. Perhaps the text originally had R-Y (ר״י), abbreviating R' Yitzchak bar Avdimi.[^1]

notes.text: רו״ר רפ״א is read contextually as Ruth Rabbah beginning-of-chapter 1, without independent named-edition verification. ר״ת means abbreviation/initials. Hyman tentatively suggests ambiguous R-Y may have stood for Yitzchak rather than Yaakov; perhaps is retained, not an attested correction or new reconstruction. Both personal title components remain R'.
